name: How to Plan Your Kitchen Countertop Replacement Project

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Design – Your journey begins with a chat about your vision, style preferences, and budget. We’ll discuss different countertop materials like quartz, granite, or solid surface, and help you understand the pros and cons of each. This usually takes a week or so as you gather ideas and get initial thoughts.
step.text: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Design – Your journey begins with a chat about your vision, style preferences, and budget. We’ll discuss different countertop materials like quartz, granite, or solid surface, and help you understand the pros and cons of each. This usually takes a week or so as you gather ideas and get initial thoughts.

step.name: Step 2: Material Selection and Templating – Once you've chosen your material, we'll take precise measurements and create templates of your existing countertops. This ensures a perfect fit for your new ones. This phase typically takes 1-2 weeks, depending on material availability and scheduling.
step.text: Step 2: Material Selection and Templating – Once you've chosen your material, we'll take precise measurements and create templates of your existing countertops. This ensures a perfect fit for your new ones. This phase typically takes 1-2 weeks, depending on material availability and scheduling.

step.name: Step 3: Fabrication and Preparation – After templating, your chosen countertop material is sent for custom fabrication based on the exact specifications. During this time, we can prepare your kitchen by disconnecting plumbing or removing old countertops if necessary, depending on the project scope. Fabrication can take anywhere from 2-4 weeks.
step.text: Step 3: Fabrication and Preparation – After templating, your chosen countertop material is sent for custom fabrication based on the exact specifications. During this time, we can prepare your kitchen by disconnecting plumbing or removing old countertops if necessary, depending on the project scope. Fabrication can take anywhere from 2-4 weeks.

step.name: Step 4: Installation Day – This is where the magic happens! Our skilled team carefully installs your new countertops, ensuring they are level, securely fastened, and properly sealed. If you’re getting new sinks or fixtures, those will be installed too. Installation itself can usually be completed in 1-2 days.
step.text: Step 4: Installation Day – This is where the magic happens! Our skilled team carefully installs your new countertops, ensuring they are level, securely fastened, and properly sealed. If you’re getting new sinks or fixtures, those will be installed too. Installation itself can usually be completed in 1-2 days.

step.name: Step 5: Final Inspection and Cleanup – We’ll do a thorough walkthrough with you to ensure everything meets your expectations. Any final touches, plumbing hookups, and a complete cleanup of the work area will be done. This final step usually takes a few hours to a day. The whole process, from start to sparkling finish, typically spans about 4-8 weeks, depending on material lead times and project complexity. We aim to keep you informed every step of the way, minimizing disruption and ensuring a beautiful outcome for your Las Vegas home.
